title: Log4Shell: Log4j2 JNDI remote code execution (CVE-2021-44228)
description: log4j-core before 2.15.0 evaluates JNDI lookups in logged messages, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution.

title: Spring4Shell: Spring Framework RCE (CVE-2022-22965)
description: spring-web 5.3.x before 5.3.18 is vulnerable to remote code execution via class loader manipulation through request parameters.

title: Jackson databind polymorphic deserialization (CVE-2019-14540)
description: jackson-databind before 2.9.10 allows unsafe polymorphic deserialization leading to remote code execution.

title: Apache Struts2 OGNL remote code execution (CVE-2017-5638)
description: struts2-core before 2.3.31 is vulnerable to OGNL expression injection in the Content-Type header, enabling unauthenticated RCE.

title: Commons Collections deserialization gadget (CVE-2015-7501)
description: commons-collections 3.x before 3.2.2 enables deserialization gadget chains that can lead to remote code execution.

title: Apache Shiro rememberMe deserialization (CVE-2016-4437)
description: shiro-core before 1.2.5 deserializes the rememberMe cookie with a default key, allowing remote code execution.
